name: Захист: мікс
description:
An attacked piece can be defended in four ways:

  • Moving away: you move the attacked piece to a safe square.
  • Blocking or interposing: you place another piece between the attacking piece and the piece that is being attacked.
  • Capturing: you capture the attacking piece.
  • Protecting: you guard the piece that is under attack.

What do you have to do?
Decide on the best defensive move to prevent material loss.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Rf4,Rf5][%cal Yh6f4,Yg6f5]} 1. Qxh6 {[%cal Gd4g7,Gh6g7]} Qf8 {[%cal Rf8h6]} 2. Qxf8+ Kxf8 3. R5f4 0-1
examples.text: Black has a double attack, but White can still win by capturing the bishop, which also suddenly threatens checkmate.
